run_relax_atoms: run a relaxation on ASE atoms with a calculator using the FIRE optimizer and default convergence settings
run_relax_atoms_with_symmetry: run a relaxation on ASE atoms while fixing structural symmetry using the FixSymmetry constraint
run_relax_atoms_with_cell_filter: run a relaxation on ASE atoms with a cell filter to allow cell optimization during relaxation
run_relax_atoms_with_observers: run a relaxation on ASE atoms and attach callback observers to monitor progress at set intervals
run_relax_atoms_with_custom_optimizer: run a relaxation on ASE atoms using a custom ASE optimizer class instead of the default FIRE
